summary: Connect operational risk, equipment reliability and safety controls. Review the five-day course outline and see how it fits your work.
lede: Risk, reliability and safety management connects operational hazard assessment with asset failure and control decisions for safety, maintenance and operations professionals. Participants learn to create risk-register entries, choose assessment methods and develop an IEC 60812-informed FMEA, while calculating basic reliability indicators and reviewing safety barriers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who assess operational hazards, maintain safety controls or make decisions about asset performance and reliability.
modules: Integrated Risk, Reliability and Safety Context
prerequisites: No coding or specialist reliability software is required. Familiarity with operational work, safety controls or maintenance records is helpful but not essential.
